content.description: Create a package-info.java file in the corresponding package to document the package and meet Checkstyle requirements.

example.after:
Before: Missing package-info.java file.
After: Create a new file named package-info.java in the same package as MavenWrapperDownloader.java and add package-level documentation.

fix_pattern.instructions: Create a package-info.java file in the corresponding package to document the package and meet Checkstyle requirements.
